title: VTC Badges — Mine — List — payload
description: A member's own badges: every badge they hold, hidden ones included, in their own order, with the offers waiting for their decision, their wall visibility and their kudos total. The signer is the subject; the payload names nothing. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: An award waiting for the signer's decision, with the badge it offers and its giver as the directory projects them to the signer.

award.description: In state `offered`; `note` is returned, it is written for the recipient.

givenBy.description: The giver's directory fields the signer may see, projected exactly as vtc/directory/entries/show would project them. Absent when the signer may see none, or when a rule made the award.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Mine — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/mine/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/mine/list/0.1#response.

badges.description: Every badge the signer holds, hidden ones included (`hidden: true`), in the signer's own order, lowest `position` first.

offers.description: Every award in state `offered` to the signer, newest first.

visibility.description: Who sees the signer's wall, as the signer set it; `members` where they never did.

kudosTotal.description: Kudos awards the signer accepted and did not hide. Present only where the community's badge settings show kudos totals (VTI-BDG-043).
